pages.title: More Than Just Food
pages.text: Dragon Breath Chili, King of Dragon Fruit, and Fasting Pills are special foods.$(br2)They do more than restore hunger and have unique effects, such as Dragon Breath Chili causing Intestinal Spasm and briefly setting you on fire.

pages.title: Liquid Food
pages.text: Urine Bottles can also be considered a special drink.$(br2)It may not sound delicious, but it can be useful in certain situations.
